html:
Evaluate valid postfix tokens using integer +, -, and *. Tokens form one expression; negative integer literals are allowed. Return its value.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      "6",
      "2",
      "-",
      "3",
      "*"
    ]
  ],
  "expected": 12
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      "-5",
      "2",
      "+"
    ]
  ],
  "expected": -3
}
Hint

Pop right operand before left operand.

Complexity: O(n) stack operations, O(n) space
